def: to tan (by sunburning); figuratively (as if by a piercing ray) to scan

occurrences.text: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.
Look not upon me, because I am black, because the sun hath looked upon me: my mother’s children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vineyards; but mine own vineyard have I not kept.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
